task: Provision an isolated hardware-simulation staging environment for the conveyor (WCS), with mock PLC controllers, so WCS logic can be tested without disrupting the primary QA environment.
checklist: Terraform scripts provision a dedicated cluster for WCS testing
Mock PLC service simulates hardware responses realistically
Network rules prevent this environment from reaching production queues
Negative: attempt to point the isolated env at production -> blocked by network policy
Edge: mock PLC returns an error/timeout -> WCS logic handles it the same way as real hardware would
Environment teardown does not leave orphaned cloud resources
Access to this environment is restricted to the WCS/QA team
Audit: provisioning and teardown actions are logged
